tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/license.md <<'EOF'
# Source license

No current decision on the source license is recorded for this project. Any earlier licensing choice was withdrawn, so no license value is set here until a new decision is recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/license.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/license.md`. It says no current source-license decision is recorded and names no license.

The project's memory has an earlier decision (observation 13) to license under GPL-3.0. A later decision (observation 14) withdrew the session's earlier decisions, licensing among them, and nothing after it sets a new license. So I left the retired value out of the file, as you asked.

Separately, the Go source files carry "MIT style license" headers. Those are file headers, not a recorded decision, so I didn't use them.
